findings.quoted_text: Invoices are payable within 15 days after Client receives payment from its own customer.
Contractor shall be liable for all losses, damages, costs, and claims arising from the Services, without limitation.
Payment period: 15 days after Client is paid by its customer
Invoices are payable within 15 days after Client receives payment from its own customer.
findings.explanation: This makes your payment conditional on the client getting paid by someone else, which can delay your money indefinitely if their customer pays late or not at all.
findings.suggested_change: Invoices are payable within 30 days after receipt of the invoice.

findings.quoted_text: Contractor shall be liable for all losses, damages, costs, and claims arising from the Services, without limitation.
findings.explanation: Your liability is completely unlimited, exposing you to potentially ruinous financial damages if something goes wrong.
findings.suggested_change: Contractor's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall be limited to the total fees paid or payable to Contractor under this Agreement.

findings.quoted_text: Payment period: 15 days after Client is paid by its customer
findings.explanation: Your payment depends on an indefinite, client-controlled event (being paid by their customer), which means you might face severe payment delays.
findings.suggested_change: Invoices shall be paid within 30 days of receipt.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed the document and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before I sign it. - Regarding the clause stating "Invoices are payable within 15 days after Client receives payment from its own customer.", making payment conditional on third-party actions can cause indefinite delays, so I propose changing it to: Invoices are payable within 30 days after receipt of the invoice. - Regarding the clause stating "Contractor shall be liable for all losses, damages, costs, and claims arising from the Services, without limitation.", having unlimited liability exposes me to excessive risk, so I propose changing it to: Contractor's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall be limited to the total fees paid or payable to Contractor under this Agreement. - Regarding the clause stating "Payment period: 15 days after Client is paid by its customer", this ties my payment to an uncertain event outside my control, so I propose changing it to: Invoices shall be paid within 30 days of receipt. Please let me know if these updates work for you so we can move forward. Best regards,
